notes.title: 正式版 v1.0
notes.content:
This is v1.0 of this game, the official version.

We fixed most of the bugs and improved system stability.
Including but not limited to:
[list]
[*] Character lagging and disability issues
[*] Invalid command problem
[*] Some sound effects playback issues
[*] The problem of not being able to repeat casting
[*] The problem of the game not ending when time runs out
[/list]
...
Although there are still many issues that can be polished and improved in the game,
But it is already a version with a stable structure and 8 charming characters with unique characteristics.
We can't wait for them to meet the contestants and hear your latest feedback.

We will continue to improve the game.
And hope you all injoy the game.


[b]May the Goddess be with you! [/b]

notes.title: 開發日誌-20241025
notes.content:

But at the same time,
We are happy to announce to you here :
[b]Another traveler from another world is about to join the competition in the near future![/b]

[b]May the Goddess be with you![/b]

notes.title: Development log-20240703
notes.content:
Hello, contestants!
I am David, the developer of Quest of Goddess.

After absorbing feedback and opinions from all players, the development team started working non-stop.
Today, we have launched several small-scale optimization and bug fixing projects as follows:

[olist]
[*] Optimized the operation guidance experience at the beginning of the game -- now both keyboard and joystick players will receive operation guidance at the very beginning of the game.
[*] Changed the schematic of the title screen -- hoping to reduce confusion among players about whether the game can only be played with a joystick.
[*] Fixed the bug where victory was not determined when there was a significant difference in remaining HP during Time UP -- now even a single hit can determine the outcome!
[*] A new IP collaboration promotional image authorized by Japan has been added to the main menu - have you all met Lamis and Hakkon?
[/olist]

The above is the optimization and repair report this time
We know there are still many issues waiting for us to deal with and we are still working on it
Any new information will be released to all participants as soon as possible. The development team thanks you for your support!

[b]May the Goddess be with you![/b]

notes.title: We NEED you help! Tell us the BUG you met!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am David, the developer of this game, Quest of Goddess .

First of all, thank you very much for your support, buying and playing the EA version of the game. Every purchase means a lot to us.
Due to the limited size of the development team, we are fully aware that the current game version still has many known or unknown issues.
[b]We are deeply sorry.[/b]
However, the development team will continue to repair and improve problems that occur, and will not stop developing new content.
So, may we ask you to give us a hand!

・Report the problems you encounter to the [BUG Report Area] of the discussion forum
・If you have any suggestions or questions for game improvement, you can post them to the [Comprehensive Discussion Forum] in the discussion area

Your assistance will help us reach our goals faster!
We will continue to work hard, and the development team thanks everyone!

[b]May the Goddess be with you ![/b]
